featured_reviews.review_text: Visited Anupam Stationery and had an excellent experience. The store is very well-organized and offers an extensive range of products. featured_reviews.review_text:
On 21st September 2024 we had purchased this 6x6 Rubik's Cube from this damn Anupam stationery. They sweetly did not issue the bill and on trust we took the product. Next day some pieces poped out and when we had gone for replacement they refused to accept as we had no bill. What a scam ? Guys better buy online they never do this. Also offline stores pls don't cry "you don't get business nowadays".  This is what you do to your customers when they trust you Huh.
-–------------------------
The story continues and this time it's positive. Guys got a call from Mr.Sachin Shah floor manager on 25/02/25 (6months later is better late than never :)} Anupam Stationery and he took cognizance of the issue and has give a replacement product. All is well that ends well. I am upgrading the ratings from 1 to 3.5. I am always for offline buying it gives product with a buying experience which online can never give. Once again kudos to Sachin Shah from Anupam Stationery for not ignoring even small issues. Well Done Dear Sachin💐
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Sorry for the inconvenience caused.

Although its a few months late, please share your contact details on anupamsuperstore@live.com for us to resolve this quickly and avoid such mishaps in future.

featured_reviews.review_text: One stop shop for all the stationary items. Located in Borivali West just opposite station. Better to visit some small shops where you will get good quality and good price. There are many shops nearby which can be explored.

featured_reviews.name: Sudhira
featured_reviews.review_text:
I would have given a minus star if I could. And it’s not about the items or cost. It is about how they manage payments in the end.
I shopped at D-Mary just yesterday. At the payment counter, I tapped my card, the machine was slow, so he refreshed it, and asked me to tap again, I did. The next minute amount got deducted from my account twice. When I asked about it, they said wait for a day, tomorrow we’ll see if you get the money back, that they will check on the back end, with the accounts team what the issue is. While I was talking to a senior, the man at the counter yells that the same problem is happening with the next customer.
He assured me that I’ll get the money back.

Today at 10 am, not a rush hour at d mart, I called that guy to check if their accounts team is there to check my issue. He said they don’t start working before 11:30 am. So I waited until 3 pm before calling him. I called him, and he said we haven’t received the amount twice, so this is a bank problem, we will give you a letter and you take that to the bank.

This whole situation is super shady. Their machine doesn’t work. My money gets deducted. And I should be the one collecting letter and going around the store and the bank? What is my fault here?

I urge the management to check the issue and resolve it asap. You can check in the attached images that the price has been deducted twice, if you see the difference.

featured_reviews.name: ShriyaReviews
featured_reviews.review_text: A wide range of products is available at affordable prices. There is also an ice cream softy shop and a sweet shop present. Additionally, customers can buy fresh fruits and vegetables here, and the customer service inside is also very good.

featured_reviews.name: James Singapuram
featured_reviews.review_text:
DMart in Powai is one of the most reliable and budget-friendly shopping destinations for daily essentials. The store is well-stocked with groceries, household items, personal care products, and kitchen essentials at prices that are usually lower than most supermarkets in the area. The variety is impressive, covering everything from fresh vegetables, fruits, dairy products, and snacks to clothing, utensils, and cleaning supplies, making it a true one-stop shop for families.

The store layout is organized, and despite being crowded on weekends and evenings, the staff manage the flow well and are generally helpful. Billing counters are multiple, which helps in reducing waiting time, though queues can still get long during peak hours. One of the best parts about DMart Powai is its consistent discounts and offers, which make bulk shopping very economical.

Parking facilities are available, but they tend to get full quickly, so visiting during non-peak hours is more convenient. The quality of products is reliable, and the overall shopping experience feels worth the time and money. For residents in and around Powai, DMart is undoubtedly a go-to place for affordable and hassle-free shopping.

featured_reviews.name: avnika kuvadiya
featured_reviews.review_text: It's one of those stores where you will surely save money. They always provide products with discounted rates, it's a very cheap and efficient store to buy from. The product range they offer is huge, almost every food item one can find along with apparels, bathroom accessories, fruits, vegetables, dairy products and what not. Dmart stores are mostly crowded, and to avoid going to the store they have a facility which one can avail by purchasing online and picking up from your place of convenience.
